content.text:
TASK:
Record the OPEN NEW SHARE capability against MERIDIAN CORE. (1) Sign on. (2) Member Inquiry -> search by Member Number for the memberId parameter -> Select. (3) Click 'Open New Share'. (4) For Share Type call choose with option = the shareType parameter value verbatim (the option's underlying value, e.g. MMKT); type the initialDeposit parameter into Initial Deposit; click Continue. (5) A review screen appears - the share is NOT yet opened. Click the committing button with irreversible=true (a human pre-authorised this recording). (6) On the confirmation screen use read to capture the new share identifier or confirmation number into an output named 'confirmationNumber' - target the value cell next to its label. (7) declare_done with capability_id 'member.openShare'.

PARAMETERS:
- memberId (internal): Caller-supplied parameter 'memberId'. — value: "100987"
- shareType (none): Caller-supplied parameter 'shareType'. — value: "MMKT"
- initialDeposit (none): Caller-supplied parameter 'initialDeposit'. — value: "25.00"
- operatorId (internal): Resolved from the environment (MERIDIAN_OPERATOR_ID) at invocation time; never stored in the artifact. — value: "teller1"
- operatorPassword (secret): Resolved from the environment (MERIDIAN_OPERATOR_PASSWORD) at invocation time; never stored in the artifact. — value: (secret — reference with param, never typed literally)

The application is served at https://web-sample.interface-hiring.com. The browser is currently blank — begin by navigating to the application.

input.intent: Open the MERIDIAN CORE banking application to begin sign on.

input.title: Open New Share for Member
input.description: Signs on to MERIDIAN CORE, looks up a member by Member Number (memberId), opens a new share of the given shareType with the given initialDeposit, and commits the opening after the review screen. Inputs: memberId, shareType (underlying value e.g. MMKT), initialDeposit, plus operator credentials. Returns the confirmation number (output 'confirmationNumber') from the Share Opened screen. The commit step is irreversible.
